topic: Parts and functions of the eyes
key_concepts: The eyes are the sense organs for seeing
The cornea is the transparent covering of the front of the eye
The iris is the colored part of the eye
The iris controls the amount of light entering the eye
The pupil is the round opening where light enters
The lens focuses light that enters the pupil
The retina is at the back of the eye and acts like a screen where the image is focused
The optic nerve sends messages about the image to the brain
The eyelids open and close to protect the eyes from too much light and injury
The eyelashes are tiny hairs on the eyelids
The eyebrows prevent water from running into the eyes
